Lina Patel: quick async check-in (what I did / blockers / today) - audits + kms
Lina Patel: did: triaged the infra audit results from yesterday, filed quick fixes for 3 low-severity items (JIRA: INFR-482, INFR-483, INFR-484)
Lina Patel: blocker: still waiting on confirmation from infra team about service account used by backup job (possible over-privileged iam role)
Lina Patel: today: follow up with infra, start the KMS key rotation plan doc, and review Samir's PR for the least-privilege iam role changes
Samir Gupta: did: ran the nightly vuln scan and re-run the SCA for the last deploy; found one dependency flagged (lodash) but patch already scheduled in DEP-129
Samir Gupta: blocker: buildkite agent 3 in us-west is flaky when scanning large images, need to requeue agent or increase timeout
Samir Gupta: today: open PR with dependency bump + test matrix, ping eng-infra for agent issue
Alex Chen: did: opened PR #842 that tightens IAM policy for redis-backup role, removed wildcard s3:* permissions
Alex Chen: blocker: need someone from infra to confirm the redis-backup CI job still has the needed kms decrypt permission before merge
Alex Chen: today: add integration test for backup job using test KMS key, update PR description with roll-forward/backout steps
Maya Ortiz: did: completed partial scan of private deployment configs, found a leftover debug key in one env var (rotated now)
Maya Ortiz: blocker: compliance needs evidence for rotation for last quarter, can anyone grab audit logs from the KMS service?
Maya Ortiz: today: assemble rotation evidence and prep short note for compliance; will also draft a runbook for key rotations
Paul Rivers: FYI I pulled logs for the KMS project: use this query in Cloud Logging to filter rotations:
Paul Rivers: ```
resource.type="cloud_kms_key_ring"
logName="projects/redwood-ops/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRing.CryptokeyVersion"
```
Paul Rivers: that should show key versions and who triggered rotations, can export to CSV
Lina Patel: thanks Paul, that helps - Maya can you confirm you saw the rotation record for the debug key?
Maya Ortiz: saw it, export attached to JIRA INFR-484, marked as evidence :white_check_mark:
security-bot: nightly-scan completed: 1 medium vuln, 3 low. See https://scans.redwood.local/scan/2026-03-16/5678 :eyes:
Samir Gupta: re: medium vuln - it's in a non-prod image, but we should still triage. I'll open a ticket and tag infra and runtime
Alex Chen: tagging @Samir for a quick review of iam test steps before I merge PR #842 :wave:
Samir Gupta: on it, will review by EOD
Lina Patel: quick ask: if anyone touches KMS keys today, please note the operation in #audits-log thread (we need chain-of-custody for compliance)
Paul Rivers: noted. I'll schedule the key rotation doc review for 3pm PT and invite Lina + Maya + Samir
Maya Ortiz: also: can someone confirm whether Dedicated environment has automated prefix caching enabled? I want to include it in the audit notes
Alex Chen: it is enabled for prod pools, not for the dedicated staging cluster. I'll add a short blurb in the audit doc
Lina Patel: excellent. If no blockers by EOD I'll start a canary rollout for the IAM changes tomorrow morning and post a short runbook here
Samir Gupta: one more thing: buildkite agent issue — @eng-infra folks, could you look at agent 3 in us-west? failing on large-scan jobs
Paul Rivers: pinged infra on the ticket, adding logs and sample job id
Lina Patel: ok team, thanks — will circle back in this thread after infra confirms the service account and when PRs are green. :thumbsup:
